_comment: Everything you can buy and eat. Edit freely -- this file is not overwritten by an update
unless you deploy with -FreshData.
hunger  how much of the stomach it fills, 0 to 1. A full meal is about 0.45.
wake    how much tiredness it takes off, 0 to 1. Caffeine only, and CAPPED in code:
it can carry you to just above the tired threshold and no further, so a
pocketful of energy drinks can never replace sleeping.
drink   true for anything you drink. Drinks give a SMALL hunger increase by design.
booze   how drunk one makes you, 0 to 1. The meter is capped at 1, so the fourth
beer does less than the first. Drink also makes tiredness come on faster
-- see [Drink] SleepMultiplier in the ini.
shop    false keeps it OFF shop counters and vending machines. For things only
one particular vendor sells -- a branded burger belongs at that door,
not on the shelf of every 24/7 in the state.
prop    what appears in your hand. EITHER one name or a LIST of candidates -- the
first that exists in your build wins, and the misses are named in the log.
A prop name is the easiest thing here to get slightly wrong and the failure
is invisible: the food still works, it just never appears in your hand.
seconds how long the eating animation runs.
vehicleSeconds  how long it runs IN A CAR. A drive-through combo is set to a
minute: you pick at it between junctions rather than gulping it.
combo   alternates the hand between the food and drinkProp every few seconds,
for anything that comes with a drink.
drinkProp  the cup, for a combo. Same single-or-list rule as prop.
Categories are the tabs across the top of the counter menu, in this order.
icon    which product shape shows in a shop. See tools/make_products.py.
tint    what colour to draw that shape, #rrggbb. The art is white.
desc    the line the shop shows. Where the character lives.
smoke   something you smoke rather than eat or drink.

items.name: Club Sandwich
items.desc: Cut into triangles by somebody who did not care.

items.name: Bleeder Burger
items.desc: Bleeds a bit. That is the name, and the experience.

items.name: Hot Dog
items.desc: Ninety per cent mystery. Ten per cent mustard.

items.name: Meat Pie
items.desc: Meat is on the label. That is as far as the label goes.

items.name: Instant Noodles
items.desc: Add water and low expectations.

items.name: Taco Bomb Taco
items.desc: Branded, shrink-wrapped and faintly warm.

items._note: Bishop's Chicken. Sold at their door only, never off a shop shelf.
items.name: Old Yeller
items.desc: Bishop's finest. Named after a dog. Do not think about it.

items._note: La Vaca Loca's drive-through board: pastrami sandwich, fries and a med soda.
items._note2: One combo, so the soda's small caffeine lift comes with it.
items.name: Pastrami Combo
items.desc: Sandwich, fries and a med soda. The board says so.

items._note: Gabrielle's Market. One of these is on the board at a time.
items.name: Bagel
items.desc: A bread product with a hole in it. Charged accordingly.

items.name: Fresh Fruit
items.desc: Nobody has bought one of these in a while.

items.name: Deli Sandwich
items.desc: Cut properly, by somebody who did care.

items._note: Aguila Burrito. Plain spelling: the accented A is not worth risking in the
items._note2: game font, and the sign says it anyway.
items.name: Aguila Burrito
items.desc: Foil-wrapped and structurally ambitious.

items._note: Ring of Fire Chilli House. Filling, and the soda is not optional.
items.name: Ring of Fire Chilli
items.desc: Named Ring of Fire. They were not being coy.

items._note: Lucky Plucker. Sold at the door AND at the drive-through lane, so it is
items._note2: set up as a combo and given a minute at the wheel.
items.name: Lucky Plucker Box
items.desc: A box of chicken and one small regret.

items._note: Cosas Baratas. Both of these are painted on the shop wall.
items.name: Tin of Sardines
items.desc: Tinned fish, on a shelf, in the sun. Bargain.

items.name: CandyBox Bar
items.desc: Box of candy. The name did all the work it was going to.

items._note: Drink. booze is how drunk one makes you; the meter caps at 1, so the
items._note2: fourth beer does less than the first. Keep buying and you get there.
items.name: Pisswasser
items.desc: Pisswasser. The name is the review.

items.name: Logger Lager
items.desc: Logger. Chops down a man twice your size.

items.name: Mount Whiskey
items.desc: Mount Whiskey, $15.99. You get what you pay for.

items._note: The 24-hour Mexican and American diner. Breakfast is on 5 to 11 only;
items._note2: the plate is what you get the rest of the day and night.
items.name: Huevos Rancheros
items.desc: Two eggs, hash browns and a coffee. Served at a reasonable hour.

items.name: Diner Plate
items.desc: Whatever is on the flat top at this time of night.

items.name: Bottle of Wine
items.desc: Wine from a shop with a security grille. Bold choice.

items._note: Fowl Mouthed Fried Chicken. Distinct from Lucky Plucker: a bucket to share
items._note2: rather than a box, so it is bigger, dearer and takes longer to get through.
items.name: Fowl Mouthed Bucket
items.desc: A bucket. For one person. Nobody is judging.

items._note: Hearty Taco, 'Eat Your Heart Out'. A sit-down plate, not the street taco
items._note2: from the hatch -- bigger, dearer, and it comes with a drink.
items.name: Hearty Taco Plate
items.desc: Eat your heart out. Their words.

items._note: Attack-A-Taco. Its own wall says HEAVY SHELLS and CHOOSE SIDES, so that is
items._note2: what it sells -- a loaded plate, distinct from Hearty Taco's and from the
items._note3: street taco at the Vespucci hatch.
items.name: Heavy Shells
items.desc: Heavy shells, choose sides. A war has broken out in your mouth.

items.name: Bag of Crisps
items.desc: Mostly air, sold by weight.

items.name: Ego Chaser Bar
items.desc: For the man who has everything, including this.

items.name: Meteorite Bar
items.desc: The candy that kids and stoners love.

items.name: P&Q Bar
items.desc: Peace and quiet. Comes in a loud wrapper.

items.name: Beef Jerky
items.desc: Chewing it counts as exercise.

items.name: Apple
items.desc: A whole apple. Revolutionary.

items.name: eCola
items.desc: Deliciously infectious. Their slogan, not mine.

items.name: Sprunk
items.desc: Sprunk up your life. Sixty grams of sugar.

items.name: Raine Water
items.desc: Water, in a bottle, for money.

items.name: Bean Machine Coffee
items.desc: Bean Machine. Tastes like the inside of a thermos.

items.name: Junk Energy
items.desc: Legally a drink. Spiritually a dare.

items.name: Orang-O-Tang
items.desc: Contains no orangutan. Contains no orange either.

items.name: Redwood
items.desc: Ask your doctor if smoking is right for you.

items.name: Debonaire
items.desc: For the discerning gentleman who wants a cough with class.

items._note: The Coop, Cluckin' Bell's walk-up kiosk. Its board is burgers, shakes, donuts, Sludgie, ice cream, pizza and hot dogs.
items.name: Cluckin' Burger
items.desc: Chicken, they say. It has been in a fryer, that much is certain.

items.name: Milkshake
items.desc: Thick enough to stand a spoon in. The straw does not stand a chance.

items.name: Donut
items.desc: Pink icing, sprinkles, no further questions.

items.name: Sludgie
items.desc: Brain freeze, sold by the cup. Legally a drink.

items.name: Ice Cream
items.desc: Melting faster than you can eat it. That is the whole game.

items.name: Pizza Slice
items.desc: Reheated under a lamp since some point this morning.

items._note: Wok It Off, the China buffet. The window says ALL YOU CAN EAT FOR $20 and SPECIAL LUNCH MENU, so it sells exactly those two things and a couple of boxes to take away.
items.name: All You Can Eat
items.desc: Twenty dollars, no time limit, no dignity. You will not need dinner.

items.name: Special Lunch Menu
items.desc: The same food, before three, for less money. Nobody knows why.

items.name: Chow Mein Box
items.desc: Comes in a box with a little wire handle. Traditional.

items.name: Wonton Soup
items.desc: Mostly broth. Two wontons, if the ladle likes you.

items._note: For the shop whose windows say BANKRUPT and REPOSSESSION SALE. Sold nowhere else, because nowhere else has given up.
items.name: Dented Can
items.desc: Label long gone, big dent in the side. Could be peaches. Could be dog food.

_animations: The two interaction animation sets used. Both are checked at load; if one will not
stream, the item is still eaten and only the animation is skipped.
